description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_IDAccumulator, which is responsible for accumulating and managing HTML element IDs to prevent duplicates within the context of HTML purification. It provides methods for building an instance with initial configuration, adding IDs, and loading multiple IDs at once.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_IDAccumulator
classes.description: A class that manages the collection of IDs to prevent duplicate IDs during HTML purification processing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static factory method to construct and initialize an IDAccumulator instance with a given configuration and context.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an ID to the accumulator, returning false if the ID is already present (duplicate).

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an array of IDs into the accumulator, marking them as taken without checking for duplicates.
